requirements.quote:
A packet is declared lost if it meets all of the following conditions:

   *  The packet is unacknowledged, in flight, and was sent prior to an acknowledged packet.
requirements.condition: When acknowledgment-based loss detection declares a packet lost
requirements.required_behavior: The packet must be unacknowledged at the time of the loss declaration.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Declaring an already acknowledged packet lost through acknowledgment-based detection.
requirements.error_behavior: No protocol error is specified; the implementation must avoid the invalid loss declaration.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can acknowledge a packet and verify that the acknowledgment-based detector does not subsequently mark that packet lost.

requirements.quote:
A packet is declared lost if it meets all of the following conditions:

   *  The packet is unacknowledged, in flight, and was sent prior to an acknowledged packet.
requirements.condition: When acknowledgment-based loss detection declares a packet lost
requirements.required_behavior: The packet must be in flight at the time of the loss declaration.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Declaring a packet that is not in flight lost through acknowledgment-based detection.
requirements.error_behavior: No protocol error is specified; the implementation must avoid the invalid loss declaration.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can arrange for a packet not to be in flight and observe whether the acknowledgment-based detector incorrectly marks it lost.

requirements.quote:
A packet is declared lost if it meets all of the following conditions:

   *  The packet is unacknowledged, in flight, and was sent prior to an acknowledged packet.
requirements.condition: When acknowledgment-based loss detection declares a packet lost
requirements.required_behavior: The packet must have been sent before an acknowledged packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Declaring a packet lost when no later-sent packet has been acknowledged.
requirements.error_behavior: No protocol error is specified; the implementation must avoid the invalid loss declaration.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet send order and acknowledgment state can be controlled and the detector's loss decision can be observed.

requirements.quote:
A packet is declared lost if it meets all of the following conditions:

   *  The packet is unacknowledged, in flight, and was sent prior to an acknowledged packet.

   *  The packet was sent kPacketThreshold packets before an acknowledged packet (Section 6.1.1), or it was sent long enough in the past (Section 6.1.2).
requirements.condition: When an unacknowledged, in-flight packet sent before an acknowledged packet was sent kPacketThreshold packets before that acknowledged packet
requirements.required_behavior: Declare the packet lost under acknowledgment-based loss detection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leaving the packet not lost after all prerequisites and the packet-threshold branch are satisfied.
requirements.error_behavior: No protocol error is specified; the loss detector must transition the packet to lost.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can construct packet send and acknowledgment order at exactly the packet threshold and inspect the resulting loss state.

requirements.quote:
A packet is declared lost if it meets all of the following conditions:

   *  The packet is unacknowledged, in flight, and was sent prior to an acknowledged packet.

   *  The packet was sent kPacketThreshold packets before an acknowledged packet (Section 6.1.1), or it was sent long enough in the past (Section 6.1.2).
requirements.condition: When an unacknowledged, in-flight packet sent before an acknowledged packet was sent long enough in the past to satisfy the time threshold
requirements.required_behavior: Declare the packet lost under acknowledgment-based loss detection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leaving the packet not lost after all prerequisites and the time-threshold branch are satisfied.
requirements.error_behavior: No protocol error is specified; the loss detector must transition the packet to lost.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can control packet age, later-packet acknowledgment, and in-flight state, then inspect the loss state when the time threshold is reached.

requirements.quote: The packet was sent kPacketThreshold packets before an acknowledged packet (Section 6.1.1), or it was sent long enough in the past (Section 6.1.2).
requirements.condition: When acknowledgment-based loss detection declares an otherwise eligible packet lost
requirements.required_behavior: At least one loss threshold must be satisfied: the packet threshold or the time threshold.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Declaring the packet lost when neither the packet threshold nor the time threshold is satisfied.
requirements.error_behavior: No protocol error is specified; the implementation must avoid the premature loss declaration.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can keep both threshold predicates false while satisfying the other prerequisites and verify that no loss is declared.

requirements.quote: Implementations with adaptive time thresholds MAY choose to start with smaller initial reordering thresholds to minimize recovery latency.
requirements.condition: When an implementation uses adaptive time thresholds
requirements.required_behavior: The implementation is permitted to initialize the adaptive mechanism with smaller reordering thresholds in order to minimize recovery latency.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Treating the use of smaller initial reordering thresholds as a protocol violation.
requirements.error_behavior: No error is required when smaller initial reordering thresholds are used.
requirements.why_checkable: Configuration and initialization tests can verify that an adaptive implementation accepts and uses a smaller initial reordering threshold without reporting a protocol error.
